name: Shadowverse
source:
-The Foreshadow-

An ominous presence has filled the skies.
People know it by one name:
The Morning Star.

It is a promise of freedom.
A glimpse of new worlds.
A light reaching oblivion.
A shadow in mortal hearts.

When darkness covers the world,
The gates of annihilation will open...

[From the [url=https://shadowverse.com/world/01/]official website[/url]]
translation:
——前兆——

不祥的存在，笼罩了天空。
人们用同一个名字称呼它：
灾厄之树。

它是自由的承诺，
是新世界的一瞥，
是伸向虚无的光，
是凡人心中的影。

当黑暗覆盖世界，
毁灭之门便会开启…

[摘自[url=https://shadowverse.com/world/01/]官方网站[/url]]
